$comment: Every limit a client must agree on with the server, read by tooling/limits-gen.mjs (decision 0123). Text limits count code points; api/text-length.vectors.json pins that on every platform.

limits.name: postBodyChars
limits.doc: A post's text.

limits.name: commentChars
limits.doc: A comment's text.

limits.name: moderationNoteChars
limits.doc: A report's note, and a moderator's reason.

limits.name: communityNameChars
limits.doc: A community's name.

limits.name: communityDescriptionChars
limits.doc: A community's description.

limits.name: communitySearchChars
limits.doc: A search for communities.

limits.name: peopleSearchChars
limits.doc: A search for people.

limits.name: groupNameChars
limits.doc: A group conversation's name, kept by the clients: the server never reads it.

limits.name: bioChars
limits.doc: A bio (decision 0115).

limits.name: pollOptionChars
limits.doc: One option of a poll.

limits.name: postMediaCount
limits.doc: Images on a post (decision 0065).

limits.name: commentMediaCount
limits.doc: Images on a comment (decision 0082).

limits.name: pollOptionsMin
limits.doc: The fewest options a poll holds.

limits.name: pollOptionsMax
limits.doc: The most options a poll holds.

limits.name: excludedPostsCount
limits.doc: Posts left out of one import.

limits.name: cardRefsCount
limits.doc: References one call for cards resolves.

limits.name: pageSize
limits.doc: The longest page of people.

limits.name: homePage
limits.doc: The longest page of the home feed.

limits.name: mediaBytes
limits.doc: A file sent in a conversation, in plaintext (decision 0023).

limits.name: imageBytes
limits.doc: An image for a post or a photo (decisions 0039, 0065).

limits.name: historyBytes
limits.doc: A history sent to a new device, in plaintext (decision 0064).

limits.name: linkRecentDays
limits.doc: How far back a link to a new device offers history.
